sampling: stratified, 62 non-survivors and 38 survivors; shuffled; no prompt tuning

survival.instructions: Based only on the supplied passenger features and your general knowledge of the Titanic disaster, predict whether this passenger survived. Estimate uncertainty; do not assume a missing value is zero. Ticket class: 1=first, 2=second, 3=third. Embarked: C=Cherbourg, Q=Queenstown, S=Southampton.

criteria.survived: The passenger survived the Titanic disaster.
criteria.did_not_survive: The passenger did not survive the Titanic disaster.

baseline: Always predict did_not_survive; also report female-survives heuristic
limitations: Known public benchmark may be present in pretraining.
Only 100 rows; descriptive demonstration, not a Kaggle leaderboard result.
No task-specific model training and no prompt selection.
